verdict.rationale: Fireflies' MCP tooling includes one documented bulk write action: `fireflies_move_meeting` moves meetings to a channel or folder, capped at 5 at a time. The transcripts query only reads lists of meetings, and sharing one meeting with many recipients is not a multi-item operation, so neither counts toward this story. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond small-batch moves (e.g. bulk delete, tag, share or update across many meetings), any batch API mutation, documented limits beyond 5 items, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: fireflies_move_meeting - Move meetings to a channel/folder (up to 5 at a time)
